description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusService class, which provides methods to manage employment status data, including CRUD operations and search functionalities, by interacting with the EmploymentStatusDao and using normalization traits.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusService
classes.description: A service class providing CRUD and search operations for employment status entities, utilizing DAO and normalization services.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusDao
methods.description: Retrieves the DAO object for employment status, instantiating it if not already set.

methods.name: setEmploymentStatusDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO object for employment status.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Fetches an employment status entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Saves the provided employment status entity.

methods.name: deleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Deletes employment statuses with specified IDs.

methods.name: searchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Performs a search for employment statuses based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employment statuses matching the search parameters.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusArray
methods.description: Retrieves all employment statuses and normalizes them into an array.
